### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory containing methylseq Bismark-route output (bismark/, fastqc/, trimgalore/, qualimap/, pipeline_info/, input/) plus the reprocessed multiqc/multiqc_data/multiqc.parquet. |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | Optional design table (TSV): sample id in a column named sample or in the first column, one column per factor. Enables the design filters and colouring and the window group comparison (on GROUP_COL, else the first two-level factor). |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Design table sample-id column. Auto-detected as the first column. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Design column the dashboards group, colour and filter by. Auto-detected as the first factor column of METADATA_FILE. The window group comparison tests it when it has exactly two levels. |
| `GENOME` | — | UCSC assembly name of the reference the run aligned to, used by the locus tracks' gene annotation and region search. |

**Auto-detected** (set from the run's metadata / `params.json`; the route flags drive *Conditional routes* below): `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY`, `ANNOTATION_COLS`

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`bismark/alignment_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bismark/alignment_summary.py) | Per-sample Bismark alignment summary, one row per library. | `sample`, `pairs_analysed`, `unique_best_hit`, `mapping_efficiency_pct`, `no_alignment`, `not_unique` |
| [`bismark/binned_methylation.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/bismark/binned_methylation.py) | Genome-wide CpG methylation in fixed windows, one row per sample per window. | `sample`, `chromosome`, `start`, `end`, `position`, `methylation_pct`, `n_cpg`, `cpg_density_class` |
